The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Bakuush]] owned a '''palace''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] where they hosted their [[Bakuush's centennial feast|centennial feast]] sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. However, several [[orpali dragon]] hatchlings that were meant to be served during the feast escaped through the palace sewers and made their way into Nal Hutta's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]], where they eventually evolved into the [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[chemilizard]]s.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bakuush's palace was first mentioned in the Codex entry for chemilizard in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
